subject.event: The analyzer's overall score for this URL falls below 40 at the scheduled September re-analysis
subject.outcomeDefinition: Analysis.overallScore < 40 for normalizedUrl https://example.com/article-8841 on the scheduled re-analysis dated 2026-09-20, run by analyzer version 2.4.x against the page as it exists on that date.
subject.resolutionSource: DeadInternetDetector scheduled re-analysis on 2026-09-20. Deliberately the same analyzer and the same methodology as the predictor.

falsifiability.basis: The September re-analysis has not been run. It will measure the page as it exists then, which producing this record does not determine.

interval.method: Bootstrap over 90-day score trajectories of comparable domains

baseline.source: Base rate of 90-day score collapse across analyzed domains
baseline.basis: Proportion of 312 domains with two analyses 90 days apart whose overall score fell below 40 in the second.

sampleSize.unit: domains with paired analyses 90 days apart
sampleSize.basis: All domains in the retention window with a re-analysis at 80-100 days' separation.

knownGaps: Domains that went offline between analyses are absent, so the sample is conditioned on survival.

outliers.handling: Eleven domains that changed ownership mid-window were retained and flagged; ownership change is a real cause of score collapse, not contamination.

regime.description: Analyzer version pinned to the 2.4.x line for the resolution run, so the scale is stable across the two measurements.

market.reason: Nothing prices a future authenticity score.
